description: App icon distribution: writes the same icon design at multiple platform sizes plus a README documenting what to use each size for.

params.readme_template:
# {display_name} app icon pack

{description}

## Files ({file_count})

This pack contains the same design at the following sizes: {size_list}.

## Recommended use

- iOS / iPadOS App Store: use the 1024x1024 file in App Store Connect.
- macOS .icns generators: feed in the 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024 sizes.
- Android Play Store: use the 512x512 file.
- Android launcher icon: use 192x192 (xxxhdpi) — closest in this pack is 256.
- Web favicon: use 32x32 for the standard favicon, 180x180 for apple-touch-icon.
- Slack / Discord workspace icon: use the 512x512 file.

All files are PNG with transparent backgrounds.
